tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
p = Path('main.go')
data = '''package main

import (
	\"crypto/rand\"
	\"fmt\"
	\"math/big\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	n, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(1<<31))
	if err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	tmpl := template.Must(template.New("greeting").Parse("Hello World {{.}}'"\\\\n\"))
	if err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, n); err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
'"'''
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.main.go.', dir='.')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, p)
except Exception:
    try: os.unlink(tmp)
    except FileNotFoundError: pass
    raise
PY
"
/bin/zsh -lc "gofmt -w main.go && sed -n '1,200p' main.go && git status --short -- main.go go.mod go.sum"
